title: Special Executive Programme In Enterprise Resource Planning
description: Unlock the potential of your business with an in-depth understanding of Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems.
longDescription: The Special Executive Program in Enterprise Resource Planning aims to equip the learner with concepts in enterprise resource planning and its association with related technologies and systems so that the learner is able to successfully integrate the ERP and other technologies within the organization. The learner will be able to identify, analyze, evaluate and choose the right ERP package for best fit of the organizational needs based on the features and cost associated with each system option and will be able to manage the development and implementation of the new system.
courseDetails: Students will examine the fundamental concepts of ERP, exploring its integrated technologies and supply chain management. The course includes detailed discussions on different ERP modules and the costs associated with implementation. Participants will also learn strategies for effective ERP system deployment in organizational contexts. After the successful completion of the course, the student will be able to learn:
